name: Image resize frame
summary: The on-canvas image frame for an editor: click to select, four corner handles resize the image by width percent (drag or keyboard), a hover mask carries Preview and Delete; it emits intents, the host owns the lightbox and the data.
lead: ONE custom element — — the editor's on-canvas image. It wraps the host's own ; the element itself is the 100% reference and the frame takes `width` percent of it. Click (or Enter / Space on the focused frame) selects it: a 2px Vivid Pink outline and four 12px corner handles appear; clicking outside or Escape deselects. Dragging any handle resizes (left handles grow leftward); each handle is a role="slider" that the Arrow keys move by `step` and Home / End jump to the floor and ceiling. The width never drops below max(`min-width` %, `min-width-px`) and never upscales past the image's natural width. Hover, keyboard focus or selection reveals a 50% ink mask with icon-only Preview (system-eye) and Delete (system-trash) buttons; the `actions` slot replaces them. It owns no lightbox and no confirm: it emits `preview`, `delete`, `select-change`, `width-input` (live) and `width-change` (committed). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, built once.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Store `width` from `width-change` (it fires once per drag, on release, and per key press) and write it back; React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Frame
spec.value: inline-block at `width`% of the host, radius 8; the slotted fills it (display:block, width 100%, radius 8)

spec.label: Selected
spec.value: 2px #E70E68 outline at offset 0 (color-primary); keyboard focus on the frame draws the same 2px ring at offset 2

spec.label: Handles
spec.value: 12×12 at each corner, 6px outside the edge, with an invisible 24×24 hit zone (44×44 under a coarse pointer); #FFFFFF fill, 1.5px #E70E68 border, radius 4, a 1px white 50% halo; nwse / nesw resize cursors; fade in with the selection (motion-fast, ease-out)

spec.label: Mask
spec.value: rgba(0,0,0,.5) (ink-a50) over the whole image, radius 8, two 36×36 icon-only aha-buttons 12px apart (Preview secondary, Delete danger, both size md); shown on hover (hover-capable pointers), keyboard focus inside, or while selected

spec.label: Resize
spec.value: drag a corner: width = start width ± pointer delta, as a whole percent of the host; floor max(15%, 120px), ceiling min(natural width, host width); one `width-change` on release

spec.label: Keyboard
spec.value: Tab to the frame; Enter / Space selects; Tab to a handle; Arrow Right / Up +step, Arrow Left / Down −step, Home floor, End ceiling; Escape deselects and returns focus to the frame

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: no selection, no mask, no handles; the frame leaves the tab order

props.name: width
props.desc: The frame's width as a percent of the host; the element writes it back on every committed resize

props.name: selected
props.desc: Shows the outline, the handles and the mask; set by click / Enter and cleared by an outside click or Escape

props.name: min-width
props.desc: Floor as a percent of the host

props.name: min-width-px
props.desc: Floor in pixels; the larger of the two floors wins, unless the image is narrower than it

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Display only: no selection, mask or handles

props.name: label / resize-label / preview-label / delete-label
props.default: Image / Resize image / Preview image / Delete image
props.desc: Accessible names for the frame group, the handles and the two default buttons (localise them)

props.name: slot (default)
props.desc: The image; its natural width caps the resize

props.name: slot="actions"
props.desc: Replaces the mask's two default buttons

props.name: preview / delete
props.desc: From the default mask buttons; the host opens its lightbox or removes the image

props.name: width-input / width-change
props.desc: Live width during a drag / the committed width on release or key press

whenToUse.when: an image placed on an editing canvas whose display width the author sets
a read-only image with no editing
a per-option image cell with Change, Edit and Delete

opinion.note: Width only, in percent of the column, never a free aspect-ratio drag and never an upscale past the image's natural size. Commit on release, not on every pointer move. The frame emits intents; the host owns the lightbox, the delete and the undo history.
opinion.dsv3: NEW — the aha-survey classic editor's hand-made CanvasImageEditor (select, four corner handles, hover mask with Preview and Delete) mapped into the DS on existing tokens. Two values moved to the nearest token: mask 45% ink → ink-a50 (50%), handle halo white 60% → white-a50 (50%). The crop and focal-point editor is not part of it.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.

Arrow keys resize from any handle (role=slider)
